event.location_text: MALACCA STRAIT Approx. 3.3 nm north of Pulau Cula (Indonesia), in the eastbound lane of the TSS Indonesia 01° 05.59' N

sources.title: Piracy monthly report September 2024
sources.text: While sailing, five perpetrators with gun-like objects were sighted in the engine room. The crew was mustered and a search conducted, but no perpetrators were found. It could not be confirmed whether any property was stolen. The crew was not injured. The master reported the incident to the Singapore Vessel Traffic Information System (VTIS) West. Safety navigational broadcast was initiated. The Republic of Singapore Navy's (RSN) Maritime Security Task Force (MSTF) and Singapore Police Coast Guard (PCG) were notified of the incident.
